title: Coherence of a module is local on an open covering
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], $\mathcal F$ an $\mathcal O_X$-module [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category] and $X=\bigcup_{i\in I}U_i$ a covering by open subschemes; for an open $W\subseteq X$ write $\mathcal F|_W$ for the restriction of $\mathcal F$ to the open subscheme $W$ ($(\mathcal F|_W)(V)=\mathcal F(V)$ for $V\subseteq W$ open, as in [lem-weil-pbc-module-restriction-open-immersion-colimits]). (1) If $\mathcal F$ is coherent [pqf-def-coherent], then $\mathcal F|_W$ is a coherent $\mathcal O_W$-module for every open $W\subseteq X$. (2) If $\mathcal F|_{U_i}$ is a coherent $\mathcal O_{U_i}$-module for every $i\in I$, then $\mathcal F$ is a coherent $\mathcal O_X$-module. (Both conditions of [pqf-def-coherent] are local: being of finite type is a condition on neighbourhoods of points, and for the kernel condition over an open $W$ one restricts to the $W\cap U_i$, kernels of $\mathcal O_X$-modules being computed sectionwise.)

source.place: Stacks, Sheaves of Modules, Definition 01BV (definition-coherent) and Definition 01B5 (definition-finite-type); the locality is used without statement in the proof of Cohomology of Schemes, Lemma 0CYJ (coherent-lemma-pushforward-coherent-on-open, literature/stacks-project/coherent.tex)

proof.text: Apply the finite-type locality core to obtain the two finite-type implications. These concern only the finite-type conjunct, not coherence of the restrictions or coherence of F.

For coherent F and an open W, the first core implication gives finite type of the restricted module. Project the kernel condition from coherence of F, and apply the kernel-condition restriction theorem. Pair these two conclusions using the definition of coherence.

For coherent restrictions on the cover, the second core implication gives finite type of F. Project their kernel conditions and apply single-kernel descent for every open W, rank n and map from the rank-n free module. Pair finite type and these kernel conditions using the definition of coherence.

proof_origin.place: Definitions 01BV and 01B5; original restriction/locality argument reduced to three strictly smaller statements. The finite-type core and both kernel-condition lemmas remain open: this is a decomposition, not an axiom-free proof.

split_report.summary: Wrote the proof in five elementary steps unwinding pqf-def-coherent (Stacks 01B5, 01BV): Step 1 collects the restriction facts (transitivity of restriction and O_X|_W=O_W from the explicit formula of the restriction node; restriction is a left adjoint, so it preserves the finite direct sums O^n and epimorphisms; kernels are sectionwise by def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category, so restriction commutes with kernels); Step 2 finite type restricts to opens (as Stacks 01B6 for j^*); Step 3 part (1); Step 4 finite type is local on an open cover; Step 5 part (2) by restricting the kernel of O_W^n -> F|_W to the W cap U_i. No new node: every argument is an instance of the definitions or of the restriction node (1). Statement and stmt_deps kept. Mathlib: no coherent sheaves of modules and no locality lemma for SheafOfModules.IsFiniteType (three kinds of search, recorded). proof_origin agent, since Stacks uses the locality without statement (0CYJ).
